title: Lead Generation for High-class Web Designer
desc:
I craft modern, conversion-focused websites and now want a steady stream of new projects. Your role is simple: connect me with small-business owners who are actively seeking a brand-new site and I will pay you US $20 for every client that signs and pays the initial deposit.

Target market
My sweet spot is the small-business segment—retail shops, health & wellness practices, tech start-ups—and I’ve also had success with real-estate agents, interior designers, plumbers, carpenters and professional photographers. Geography is wide open, with current emphasis on North America, Canada, Europe and Asia, so you can prospect wherever your network is strongest.

What I need from you
• Warm introductions or directly closed deals for a full website build.
• A brief written overview of each lead’s needs (industry, size, desired features, budget range).
• Confirmation that the lead knows my pricing starts at standard market rates and is ready to move forward.

How you get paid
The moment a referred client pays the kickoff invoice, I release your US $20 commission—no waiting for project completion. Bring in multiple clients and you’ll earn multiple payouts; there’s no cap.

If you already have contacts who fit this profile or you’re confident in your outreach ability, let’s start immediately.

desc:

Because these models are solely for marketing presentation, visual appeal is paramount: clean topology, precise surface transitions, and materials that look believable under studio lighting. Once each model is approved, I’ll also need two to three high-resolution rendered views (PNG or JPEG) that showcase the product in a neutral environment.

Deliverables
• Native AutoCAD (.dwg) file for each prototype  
• Exported universal formats (.STEP or .IGES) for potential cross-platform edits  
• 2–3 high-resolution marketing renders per model  

I can share reference sketches, basic dimensions, and brand style guidelines as soon as we start. Let me know your typical turnaround time per prototype and any similar portfolio pieces so I can gauge fit and schedule the first milestone right away.

title: Manual Enhancement of Two Voices
desc:
I have a two-minute casual conversation captured on a single track with three speakers. Speaker A sits well in the mix, but the passages from Speaker B and Speaker C are buried. I need both their volume and clarity brought up to match Speaker A, while keeping the tone natural and free of artifacts.  

Please run a gentle broadband noise reduction across the entire recording to tame the room hiss, yet preserve the ambience so it still feels authentic. Because this is a sensitive personal matter, avoid any AI-based speech reconstruction or voice cloning; rely solely on traditional audio-engineering techniques such as EQ, multiband compression, spectral repair, and manual gain riding.  

Deliverables  
• One cleaned stereo WAV (or AIFF) at the original sample rate/bit depth  
• A concise note describing the processing chain and key settings applied  

Keep every other element untouched, and return the finished file within 48 hours. Confidentiality is essential—delete any working copies once the project is handed over.

• Revenue-share model: no upfront fee—your commission is tied directly to the conversions your edits generate. I track each clip’s performance so payouts remain transparent.

There’s no hard deadline; consistency is more important than speed. If you already cut short-form drama, send a link to your portfolio and note any past TikTok successes. Looking forward to building a long-term partnership where great storytelling meets shared upside.

title: Hindi Novel Translation & Typing
desc:
A complete Hindi novel currently exists only in hard-copy form. The project involves two intertwined tasks. First, every word of the printed text must be retyped with absolute accuracy, keeping chapter breaks, dialogues, and any stylistic emphasis exactly as on the page so I can work with an editable manuscript. Immediately after, that freshly typed Hindi file needs to be rendered into smooth, idiomatic prose in the target language—English is my initial preference, though I’m open to discussing another language if it better suits your expertise.

Faithfulness to the author’s tone, cultural nuance, and emotional flow is crucial; the translation should read like an original novel, not a literal word-for-word copy. A solid grasp of literary Hindi, contemporary vocabulary, and narrative pacing will make the difference here.

Deliverables:
• Clean, proof-read Word document of the full Hindi text  
• Parallel Word document containing the complete translation, formatted to mirror the original (chapter titles, paragraph breaks, footnotes if present)

Please outline a realistic timeline for both typing and translation, along with any preferred tools (e.g., MS Word, Google Docs, CAT software) so I can coordinate review milestones. Completion of a brief sample page may be requested before we finalize the schedule.

• Revit (.rvt) model with LOD suitable for detailed construction documents  
• Complete sheet set: floor plans, sections, elevations, and construction/working drawings formatted for print  
• Schedules generated directly from the model (doors, windows, finishes, etc.)  

I will supply reference PDFs/CAD, title block, and any project standards you require immediately after award.

title: Analisi statistica tesi ginecologia
Heavy-Duty Precision Rail System

title: Structural Engineer with PE Stamp for NC Steel Frame
desc:
I have already run the full structural calculations for a light-steel frame that will carry a single-steel frame in North Carolina. what I need now is a formal peer review and professional stamp from a NC PE so the package glides through local plan check.

Your review should focus primarily on the load assumptions, with particular attention to wind loading. Please verify that everything aligns with IBC 2021 for wind and standard engineering practice. If you spot anything that warrants adjustment, concise red-line comments in the PDF are all I need—I will revise and return the final copy for your signature.

Turnaround speed is important, but accuracy is paramount. Let me know your typical review window and any documentation you require up front so we can keep this moving.

title: Digitize Handwritten Manuscript into PDF
desc:

You will receive high-resolution scans as soon as we start. The writing is generally clear, but there are occasional margin notes and strike-throughs that must be captured exactly as written. Accuracy matters more than speed; spelling, punctuation, and line breaks should match the source.

Deliverables
• One PDF containing the fully typed text, page-for-page with the manuscript.  
• (Optional, but helpful) a simple .txt or .docx copy for future edits.

Acceptance criteria
• Every page transcribed with an error rate below 1 % on a random check.  
• PDF opens flawlessly in Adobe Acrobat and is fully searchable.

Let me know your estimated turnaround time and which tools—OCR, manual typing, Adobe Acrobat, etc.—you prefer to use. I will provide a brief NDA before sharing the scans to keep the content confidential.

desc:

title: Manuscript Digitization to Custom PDF

title: CA Needed: GST & TDS
desc:
I need a qualified Chartered Accountant to keep my Indian-registered Private Limited company fully compliant with its recurring tax obligations. The immediate scope is limited to filing all GST returns and the corresponding TDS returns on time and in the correct format each period.  

What I expect from you  
• Prepare and file every mandatory GST return (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, annual reconciliation, etc.) and all required TDS returns, including timely generation of Form 16/16A.  
• Reconcile sales, purchases, input credit, and challans against the books before submission.  
• Advise me when data or documents are missing so I can supply them quickly—your reminders keep us penalty-free.

What is Data?

Data is a collection of raw facts, numbers, text, images, or symbols that can be processed to produce meaningful information.

Examples:

Student name
Age
Roll number
Marks
Mobile number
Information

Information is processed and organized data that has meaning.

Example:
Marks = 85, 90, 88 (Data)

Importance of Data Management
Improves decision-making
Reduces errors
Saves time
Increases security
Supports business growth
Helps in reporting and analysis
Unit 2: Types of Data
1. Structured Data
Organized in rows and columns
Stored in databases
Easy to search

Example: Student database

2. Semi-Structured Data
Not completely organized
Uses tags or labels

Example: XML, JSON

3. Unstructured Data
No fixed format

Example:

Images
Videos
Emails
PDF files

A database is an organized collection of data stored electronically.

title: Positive SEP Proposal Feedback -- 2
desc:
I’m preparing an official comment on a Standards Enhancement Proposal and need a concise, persuasive write-up that focuses on the proposal’s overall concept. The goal is to highlight the strongest elements—innovation, feasibility, and potential impact—so decision-makers immediately see its value.  

You’ll receive the draft SEP and any background notes as soon as we start. From that, craft a clear, well-structured comment (roughly 300–500 words) that:

• Opens with a brief summary of the concept in plain language  
• Showcases key strengths with concrete reasoning or real-world parallels  
• Maintains a professional yet supportive tone suitable for board review  

Please deliver the comment in editable text (Google Docs or Word). A quick turnaround is appreciated, but quality of analysis is paramount.

title: Beginner IELTS Full-Module Coaching
desc:
I have a group of beginner-level candidates who want to raise their overall IELTS band, not just patch up one or two skills. They need a trainer who can guide them through every module—Speaking, Listening, Reading, and Writing—while steadily building confidence and test-taking discipline.

Here’s what I need from you:  
• A structured syllabus that strings the four skills together week by week, showing clear milestones for band improvement.  
• Live, interactive sessions (Zoom, Google Meet, or a comparable platform) that balance theory with timed practice.  
• Original or curated practice sets drawn from reliable sources such as Cambridge IELTS books, British Council materials, and up-to-date online mock tests, plus your own feedback rubric.  
• Regular full-length mock exams, marked with detailed band-by-band commentary so students can track progress.  
• Practical strategies for pacing, note-taking, and anxiety control that beginners can grasp quickly.

Acceptance criteria  
1. A lesson plan covering at least six weeks with measurable learning outcomes.  
2. One complete mock-test package delivered before week three.  
3. Written feedback templates showing band descriptors for each module.  
4. End-of-course report summarising score movement for every learner.

If you’ve successfully taken absolute beginners to their target bands before and can show samples of your feedback style, I’d love to see them. Let’s give these students the comprehensive start they deserve.

title: Women's Garment Tech Pack Development
desc:
We are looking for an experienced Fashion Technical Designer / Tech Pack Designer to create detailed, production-ready tech packs for women's apparel.

The designs will include categories such as western dresses, tunic tops, kurtis and co-ord sets.

We will provide:
Garment design/reference images
Fabric images/details
Intended garment category and overall fit
Colour requirements
Size range
Any specific design or construction requirements available

The freelancer is expected to translate the design into a technically accurate tech pack that can be shared directly with a garment manufacturer for sample development.

Scope of Work – Per Garment

TECHNICAL FLAT SKETCHES
Detailed front flat
Detailed back flat
Side/detail views where required
Accurate representation of neckline, sleeves, seams, darts, panels, pockets, closures, slits, hems, etc.
Enlarged construction/detail sketches wherever required

GARMENT CONSTRUCTION DETAILS
Clearly specify:
Seam construction
Stitch types
Seam allowance where applicable
Hem construction
Neck finishing
Sleeve/cuff finishing
Plackets
Zippers/buttons/hooks and other closures
Pocket construction
Facing/interfacing/lining requirements
Top-stitching
Special finishing instructions

The factory should be able to understand how the garment is intended to be constructed without relying only on the reference photograph.

BILL OF MATERIALS (BOM)
Prepare a detailed BOM covering:
Main fabric
Contrast/secondary fabric
Lining
Interlining/interfacing
Thread

title: Accurate PDF-to-Word Transcription
desc:
I have a set of text-heavy scanned PDFs that need to be reproduced in Microsoft Word while preserving every element of their original layout—fonts, headings, spacing, and any subtle formatting cues. Your task is straightforward but detail-oriented: convert each page so that the new Word file mirrors the source page for page, line for line.  

Please ensure:  
• Exact replication of formatting rather than a simplified redesign.  
• Clean, editable text free of recognition errors or stray line breaks.  
• A brief proofread as you work so obvious typos from OCR are corrected on the fly.  

I will supply the PDFs electronically; simply return the finished .docx files in the same sequence. Let me know your turnaround time and any experience you have with OCR tools or manual retyping for high-accuracy projects, and we can get started right away.

title: Professional Job Update Reels
desc:
I’m looking for a creator who can turn weekly job-market updates and new vacancy postings into concise Instagram Reels (15–20 seconds each). Over the course of a month I’ll need a total of 30 reels, delivered in four weekly batches so I can review and schedule them in advance.

Here’s what matters:  
• Content: every reel will highlight current openings, hiring trends, or quick career tips relevant to our audience of young professionals.  
• Style: I want a polished blend of talking-head footage and clean animated graphics so the information stays engaging while maintaining a corporate look.  
• Tone: keep it formal and professional—think LinkedIn energy, just in vertical video form.  
• Specs: 1080 × 1920, native for Instagram, with captions burned in, subtle branding, and royalty-free background music.  

Please include a couple of sample reels (or links) that showcase this mixed format so I can gauge pacing, motion-graphic quality, and on-camera delivery. If selected, you’ll receive the weekly brief every Monday and the raw script or bullet points to work from, along with logo assets and brand colours.

Deliverables each week:  
1. 7–8 fully edited reels (mp4)  
2. Separate .srt caption files  
3. Thumbnail suggestions

I’ll provide prompt feedback so revisions stay minimal. Looking forward to seeing how you can bring professional job updates to life in a snappy, scroll-stopping way.

title: Dubai Travel Expo Photography Coverage
desc:
I’m looking for a skilled event photographer from UAE who can spend one full day with me at an upcoming travel exhibition in Dubai and deliver a vivid, story-driven record of the show. The priority is true event coverage, with particular attention on two key areas throughout the day:  

• Networking sessions – the informal conversations, introductions, and handshake moments that happen across the floor.  
• Booth interactions – live demos, visitor engagement, and any spontaneous brand-visitor exchanges.  

After the shoot I’ll need the images taken through an advanced post-production workflow. Think careful retouching, tasteful enhancements, and any special effects that help the final gallery reflect the energy of the expo while still looking authentic. A solid command of Lightroom and Photoshop (or comparable tools) will be essential here.

Deliverables  
• A curated set of high-resolution, fully retouched images supplied via downloadable link within an agreed timeframe.  
• A smaller web-ready selection optimized for quick social sharing.

If this sounds like your wheelhouse and you’ll already be in Dubai (or can arrange travel), let’s talk through timing, access badges, and any gear specifics you prefer to bring.

title: Kids App Testing & Storywriting
desc:
Fulltime/Permanent -8hrs/day employment (Rs20k to RS25k per month):
I need a detail-oriented tester who can comb through my early-learning app for children aged 1-4 and verify that every feature works exactly as intended. Your focus will be pure functional testing: tapping every button, triggering each interactive element, and confirming that sounds, animations, and progress tracking all behave correctly on both iOS and Android. For every defect you find, log the exact steps to reproduce, expected versus actual behaviour, and a quick severity rating so my dev team can fix it fast.

At the same time, I’d like a fresh batch of short, AI-generated stories that match the same 1-4 age range. Think simple vocabulary, lots of repetition, gentle humour and clear morals. You’re free to use any large-language-model platform you like (ChatGPT, Claude, Jasper, etc.) as long as the final stories are proof-read by you and free of copyright conflicts.

Deliverables  
• Complete test report with screenshots or screen-captures for every defect  
• Five original toddler stories (150–250 words each) delivered in DOCX and plain-text formats  

I’m ready to start right away and happy to answer any technical questions you have so you can dive straight in.

title: Timely Political News Reports - 15/09/2026 16:16 EDT
desc:
I’m assembling a small bench of writers who can deliver crisp, accurate political news reports on demand. My own background is in journalism, so I’ll supply leads, verified sources, and the editorial angle; what I need from you is clear, impartial copy that can be published with minimal edits.

Here’s how the workflow looks:
• I’ll send you a brief each morning—headline, key facts, and primary sources.  
• You craft a 600-800-word report that follows standard news style, hits deadline, and stays neutral in tone.  
• Fact-check names, dates, and quotes before filing; attribution must be airtight.  
• Submit in Google Docs so I can leave live comments for any tweaks.

Turnaround is usually four to six hours from assignment. If you’re comfortable under that clock, and you have a proven track record covering politics—local, national, or international—let’s start with a paid test piece and build from there.

title: Higher Education Article Content Manager
desc:
I run an online learning platform aimed squarely at the higher-education market and need someone who can take full ownership of our article workflow. At present we publish only written pieces—no videos or interactive modules—so your focus will be on planning, commissioning, editing, and releasing articles that resonate with university-level learners.

Subjects you’ll handle span Science and Technology, Humanities and Arts, and Business and Economics. That breadth means coordinating with a diverse pool of academic authors, fact-checking across disciplines, and shaping every piece so it meets scholarly standards while staying engaging and accessible.

Day-to-day you’ll be working inside our CMS, refining copy for clarity and SEO, scheduling releases, and tracking performance analytics to inform the next content cycle. Consistency of tone, proper citation, and on-brand visuals are all key.

Deliverables I expect each month:  
• A detailed editorial calendar with proposed topics and deadlines  
• Fully edited, ready-to-publish articles (including metadata and internal links)  
• A short performance report highlighting wins, gaps, and data-driven next steps  

Articles should hit agreed word counts, reference reputable sources, and follow our in-house style guide (APA citation base). If you have experience managing multi-disciplinary academic content and enjoy turning complex ideas into engaging reading, I’d love to hear how you’d approach the first 30 days.

title: Flash TRC20 Token Builder
desc:
I need a stand-alone application that lets me spin up and deploy TRC20 tokens on the Tron network in minutes for my own personal projects. The core task is token creation, but I want the process wrapped in a clean, beginner-friendly interface so I don’t have to touch the command line every time.

Key capabilities I expect:
• User-friendly interface – clear forms for token name, symbol, supply, decimals and optional parameters.  
• Customizable token parameters – burn, mint, freeze, pausable or any other standard flags should be toggleable before deployment.  
• Automatic deployment scripts – a single click compiles, deploys and returns the contract address (supporting both Shasta testnet and mainnet).

Under the hood you can choose the stack (Python, Node.js, or another language you prefer) as long as it interfaces smoothly with TronWeb / TronGrid and keeps private keys secure. I’ll need the executable, readable source code, and short documentation that shows how to install, generate a wallet, fund it, and push a new token live.

Acceptance is straightforward: I run the app, enter my parameters, press Deploy, and receive a verified TRC20 contract address that works in TronLink.

title: Accurate Handwritten Records Conversion
desc:
I have a collection of handwritten records that I need transcribed into clean digital files. The notes are only somewhat legible, so this is very much a manual typing project rather than a quick OCR job. Accuracy is crucial: each word has to be checked carefully, and any bullet-point or list structure that appears on the page must be reproduced exactly in the final document.

You are free to use Microsoft Word, Google Docs, or another standard word-processing tool—what matters most is that the finished file is error-free, neatly formatted, and ready for immediate use. If you prefer a specific file type, let me know; I’m flexible as long as the layout remains intact.

Deliverable:
• A fully typed, proof-read document (or documents), with all original bullet lists preserved.

Before we wrap up, I will spot-check random pages to confirm that spelling, punctuation, and list hierarchy match the source material. Once everything passes that check, the project is complete.

title: Urgent Florida PE Digital Signature
desc:
I have a set of structural engineering plans that must be electronically sealed for submission to the Florida permitting portal. I need a Florida-licensed Professional Engineer who already holds a Certificate Authority–issued digital signing certificate that the Florida Board accepts (the .pfx/.p12 file, not a scanned image or wet stamp).

Scope  
• Apply your FL PE digital signature and seal to the final PDF plans (structural discipline).  
• Return a signed PDF that passes the state’s electronic verification system, along with the signature validation report.  

Turnaround  
Timing is critical: I am ready to release the files as soon as we agree, and I need the signed set back the same day—or overnight at the latest.

Payment  
The total budget is $250; I will fund the milestone in full and release it immediately once the signature is verified on the portal.

If you are an active Florida PE with the required CA certificate and can meet the timeline, let’s move forward now.

title: Japanese Casual Transcription and Voice-Over
desc:
I have an English script that needs to be translated into natural-sounding Japanese and recorded as a narration in a relaxed, conversational tone. Once you’ve translated the copy, record the voice-over in a quiet space with clear, balanced audio (WAV or high-bit-rate MP3 is fine).  

Timing or lip-sync isn’t critical; what matters most is that the pacing feels smooth and listener-friendly. If you normally supply two or three takes of tricky lines, that would be appreciated.  

Please include a short sample of your voice in a similar style when you bid, and let me know which mic/interface you’ll use so I can be sure the final file will be broadcast-quality. Looking forward to hearing your voice bring this project to life.
